data.name: Hook and Gun
data.detailed_description:
INFILTRATE, CORRUPT, AND ESCAPE!

Hook and Gun is a brutal, fast-paced 2D top-down action roguelike set within the claustrophobic confines of a rising elevator. You are an alien invader that has breached a high-security robot factory. Your objective is simple: take control of a security unit, reach the top floor, corrupt everything in your path, and unleash yourself upon the world.

CORE FEATURES

  • Hook 'em and Rob 'em: You don’t just shoot; you plunder. Use your advanced grappling hook to pull enemies close or, more importantly, rip the weapons right out of their hands. Once stolen, every weapon becomes even more lethal under your corruptive influence.

  • The Relentless Ascent: The arena is a moving elevator. Each floor brings more aggressive security droids and deadlier waves. Survival isn't enough—once the timer hits zero, you must eliminate all remaining elite units to clear the path to the next floor.

  • Dynamic Arena Events: You aren't just fighting robots; you're fighting the facility itself. From toxic gas leaks that shrink the playable area to sudden malfunctions, you’ll need to adapt your strategy in seconds.

  • Scrap & Evolve: Shred enemy robots and harvest their components to level up mid-combat. At the end of each floor, use your earned level points to unlock dozens of new abilities or upgrade existing ones in a true roguelike fashion. With over 10 weapon types and specialized hook modifications you can craft a unique "corrupted" build in every run.

WHY HOOK AND GUN?

  • High-Octane Combat: Speed is survival. Transform your hook from a mobility tool into a devastating instrument of war and manipulation.

  • Biopunk Aesthetic: Experience a dark, mechanical world where metal meets flesh and code meets virus. You are the glitch in their perfect system.

  • Infinite Replayability: With randomized talents, weapon variations, and increasingly difficult elevator floors, every failure is just data for your next successful escape.

Take control. Corrupt the facility. Infect the world.

data.short_description: A fast-paced 2D top-down action roguelike set in a rising industrial elevator. Use your grappling hook to snatch, corrupt, and turn enemy weapons against them. Battle through relentless waves of security robots, harvest scrap to unlock powerful upgrades and survive the ascent to escape the facility.
